name: Admin Document Send Email
description: Admin sends a branded email with document PDFs attached from the documents list: actions sheet -> 'Enviar por correo' opens SendDocumentEmailModal -> POST /api/emails/send/ with document_ids. After delivery, an in-modal step identifies eligible document targets and offers to open Enviado episodes with origin=email; sending remains successful if the optional state transition is declined.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign): happy path, 429 rate-limited and generic-error branches over mocked API.
